_comment: Cyrillic literal allowlist (D-14, QUAL-05). Every entry names a string literal that carries Cyrillic and is sanctioned to keep it. Consumed by t/unit/locale_cyrillic_watchdog.js: an entry exempts exactly one file+line, an entry whose line no longer holds a Cyrillic string literal is PHANTOM and fails the build (an allowlist entry must keep matching a real anchor, T-05-07), and every entry carries a mandatory reason so growth shows up in review diffs. Two shapes live here by design: (1) model-level seed defaults that become stored per-row data rather than request-locale-rendered text, and (2) model validator/invariant messages that have no request context and never reach an API payload directly (the routes emit translated req.t() errors for the same conditions).

entries.reason: Seed default department name ('Продажи' for CIS countries, 'Sales' otherwise) chosen at company creation: stored as per-row data, not request-locale-rendered text — translating per request would corrupt stored rows (D-14 sanctioned shape 2)
